name: magat
description: Magat River basin above Magat Dam, Luzon, Philippines. RRI 1.4.2.7, 1 land-use class, diffusion-wave slope routing.
thresholds_basis: Scaled from the MAGAT-DAM frequency curve by each point's own peak on the Nov-2020 calibration event. No independent frequency analysis exists for these points.

stations.name: Magat Dam

thresholds.basis: Supplied flood-frequency analysis for Magat Dam, 2Y-100Y. Levels read at Q5 / Q25 / Q100. Note the near-flat 10Y-25Y interval and the steep 50Y-100Y tail.

stations.note: The model has no reservoir operation, so this is the natural inflow arriving at the dam, not the release downstream of it.

thresholds.basis: Inherited from the MAGAT-DAM frequency curve. The two cells differ by 0.2% in modelled peak flow, but no independent analysis exists here.

stations.name: San Lorenzo Bridge

thresholds.basis: Scaled from the MAGAT-DAM frequency curve by each point's own peak on the Nov-2020 calibration event. No independent frequency analysis exists for these points.

stations.note: The model's river channel runs 5-8 km west of the real Magat here. This forecast is the model's Magat main stem at the matching point (2,020 km2, 6.6 km west of the bridge); it misses a ~300 km2 side stream, so discharge is probably 10-15% low and water level is for the model channel, not the bridge.
